topic: Mutual Fund and ETF Fees and Expenses
subtopic: Annual Operating Expenses and Expense Ratios
source_evidence: Total Annual Fund Operating Expenses (Expressed as a % of the fund’s average net assets, called the expense ratio)
answer: Annual operating expenses are recurring costs of running a mutual fund or ETF. They can include management fees, distribution or service fees, and other expenses. The fund pays these costs from its assets rather than charging them to you as a separate bill. The total annual operating expenses are shown as a percentage of the fund’s average net assets; this percentage is called the expense ratio. Because these costs are paid from fund assets, they reduce the value of the fund and investors’ shares, and therefore reduce investment returns.
